> **dannybeewrote:↑Thu Feb 17, 2022 4:11 pm:** i was watching a method for making Diy Kodachrome film using 3 batches of premade AgX with 3 difrent dyes then mixing them together and adding hardener and coating plates wonder if color holographic plate can be done this way, rather than mixing all 3 dyes to one batch when making the Agx? any ideas on this?

I don't see why it wouldn't work. It may actually be an even more promising approach - in order to avoid compatibility issues with the sensitizing dyes.
